Click the box in the options for 'Always Show Tool Hit Location' otherwise you're likely to hit the wrong thing. Otherwise I'd recommend keeping an eye out for worms (they look like squiggly lines in the ground; they give you items, like books (they'll give you more info)) and watch the TV regularly - there's a channel called 'Livin' Off the Land' that gives out tips, there's another that'll teach you new cooking recipes, and there's a weather channel.

Rebuild the bridge by the fisherman's pier thing as soon as you can, you'll get quite a bit of extra cash picking up coral and whatnot from over there when it rains.

When nobody is nearby, check the garbage cans in town.

Talk to townspeople you want to get closer to, and give them gifts if you want to work towards a relationship. Watch the birthdays on the calendar, gifts have more impact then.

Farm your ass off, but watch out for the end of the month.
Get the quality sprinklers. They're amazing. The normal ones kind of suck.

When you upgrade your ax enough to take down the hardwood logs, go to the area below your house and head all the way to the top left corner. Cut up the log there and it'll open a small little forest area that has 12 units of hardwood regrow every day.

Also: Upgrade your hoe and water can in winter when you can't grow crops. Invest early in a horse.
